description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (TagsRecyclerAdapter) for displaying tags within a user interface, supporting diffing for efficient updates and handling item view creation and binding.

classes.name: TagsRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for handling a list of TagData objects, with diffing support.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new view holder and inflates the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder (with payloads)
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder, supporting partial updates via payloads.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item at the given position.

inner_classes.name: DiffCallback
inner_classes.description: DiffUtil.ItemCallback implementation for comparing TagData items for efficient updates.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two items represent the same entity based on their ID.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two items are the same.

methods.name: getChangePayload
methods.description: Returns a payload indicating what changed between old and new items.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Method called to update specific parts of the view holder based on payloads (assumed to be implemented in TagsViewHolder).
